SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover, c.owner_id, c.member_count, c.post_count, c.category, c.status, c.created_time, pu.nickname AS owner_name, pu.avatar AS owner_avatar FROM portal_circle c LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.status = 'active'
AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR c.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND c.category = #{query.category}
ORDER BY c.member_count DESC, c.created_time DESC
ORDER BY c.member_count DESC, c.created_time DESC
ORDER BY c.created_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover, c.owner_id, c.member_count, c.post_count, c.category, c.status, c.created_time, pu.nickname AS owner_name, pu.avatar AS owner_avatar FROM portal_circle c LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.id = #{id}

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover, c.owner_id, c.member_count, c.post_count, c.category, c.status, c.created_time, pu.nickname AS owner_name, pu.avatar AS owner_avatar FROM portal_circle c LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = c.owner_id WHERE c.owner_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.description, c.cover, c.owner_id, c.member_count, c.post_count, c.category, c.status, c.created_time, pu.nickname AS owner_name, pu.avatar AS owner_avatar FROM portal_circle c INNER JOIN portal_circle_member m ON m.circle_id = c.id AND m.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = c.owner_id ORDER BY m.joined_time DESC

SELECT m.id, m.circle_id AS circleId, m.user_id AS userId, m.role, m.joined_time AS joinedTime, pu.nickname, pu.avatar FROM portal_circle_member m LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = m.user_id WHERE m.circle_id = #{circleId} ORDER BY FIELD(m.role, 'owner', 'admin', 'member'), m.joined_time ASC
LIMIT #{limit}
